### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

  - no 「.custom」「基座」「只读」 in the zh body;
  - a 44 px target at 375 px.
- **The riskiest hunk is sound.** The `loadPackageLessSurfaces` effect is cancel-safe. It reads once per visit, uses the same read as the `~org` scope, and a failed read draws the entry with no number, so the scope stays reachable.
- **The checklist revision is consistent with the hidden-at-0 entry.**

## Must-fix

**M1. The card's added acceptance line is not addressed.** Comment 6943119575 on #34715 (08:42Z, after the claim) adds one line to this card: system packages leave "Installed apps", by the same rule as #34593's switcher. The new acceptance line is: "on a hosted environment, no `sys.`-prefixed package in Installed apps". Neither the PR body nor the os-dev report mentions it, and the code does not do it:
- `readonly = cards.filter((p) => !p.writable)` in `BuilderLanding.tsx:151` keeps every non-writable row.
- `parsePackages` (`packages-io.ts:104–118`) skips only the manifest-scoped kernel rows. It KEEPS the flat-`scope: system|cloud` rows (e.g. `sys.env-artifact-cache`), tagging them `kernel: true`. So those still draw as installed apps, now with a Customize button.

Two ways to close it:
- **(a) Filter them out.** Drop `kernel`-tagged rows from the installed section. That is the predicate #34677's `offeredPackages` uses, and the tag is already on `main`. Add one pin, plus one live or stand-in reading with a flat `sys.*` row present (#34677's readings used a response stand-in).
- **(b) The seat rules it out of this card.** The seat records why on the card, and the PR body says so, since `Fixes #34715` closes the card.

(a) is one line plus a pin, and is what the card now asks.

## Should-fix

**S1. The claim's Scope line no longer matches the PR (seat).** Claim 6943017877 says "Recently viewed keeps leading when there are recent packages (objectui#11863)". d247d947 moves it after "Your own apps" so installed apps lead, and the PR body and the report state this as a deviation. It is a reasonable reading of acceptance 1. The claim should say the same, so a claim amendment from the seat would help.

## Notes

- **Own apps keep their id and Writable badge.** The card's hide-the-id item names installed cards only, so this reading is fine.
- **The pinned thread branch** `claude/project-thread-eqwj27` is declared in the claim and the body.
- **The step-1 "customizations in this environment" block is #34714's,** and the body says so.
- **Routing.** Not governed. After ACCEPT, o3-D lands it. If M1 is answered by (a), I read the delta on the new head.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [44066247100](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44066247100) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test Core (3/10)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44066247100/job/133981836522)** — 失败步骤: Run this shard's tests

  ```
  @objectstack/runtime:test:  FAIL   local  src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts > [#34040 item 4] the bare doc doors beside two enabled holders of one doc name, 'alpha registered firs
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/runtime:test: AssertionError: {"type":"doc","name":"shared_doc","code":{"name":"shared_doc","label":"alpha doc","content":"# alpha","_packageId":"com.qa.alpha","_packageVersion":"1.0.0","
  @objectstack/runtime:test:  FAIL   local  src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts > [#34040 item 4] the bare doc doors beside two enabled holders of one doc name, 'beta registered first
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/runtime:test: AssertionError: {"type":"doc","name":"shared_doc","code":{"name":"shared_doc","label":"beta doc","content":"# beta","_packageId":"com.qa.beta","_packageVersion":"1.0.0","_pr
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts` — 24h 内已弹出 **5 个 PR**（#34238、#34347、#34663、#34731、#34747），但它们同属 **1 条投机栈** ⇒ **1 次独立命中**。汇总 issue：#34772（已刷新）
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 19 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
